start: You couldn’t bust a grape in a food fight.

table: Table fruit. Clean line. No alibis.

cluster: Five Pips underneath it and still no union.

lug: That is not ammunition. That is inventory fraud.

hit: Put that stain in the permanent record.
hardHit: Two bottles gone. That one had paperwork.

near: Half a boot. The Pips will argue about it all winter.
miss: You threw a grape at Kansas and Kansas won.

self: Harvested himself. Efficient, in a legal sense.

split: Bunch broke clean. Everybody gets blamed.
streak: Back-to-back stains. Somebody found the range.

playerWin: Vinegar. Seal the Late cart and sweep the stems.

playerLose: You couldn’t bust a grape in a food fight.
